allOf.description: The token that represents this task. Task tokens are generated by Step Functions when tasks are assigned to a worker, or in the context object when a workflow enters a task state. See GetActivityTaskOutput$taskToken.
The JSON output of the task. Length constraints apply to the payload size, and are expressed as bytes in UTF-8 encoding.
